item.title: Reference-Guided Mesh Coloring with Blender MCP
item.description: A comprehensive architectural blueprint for extending blender-mcp-bridge to automatically ingest untextured STL models, align reference photos, execute semantic face selection, and project colors/textures onto 3D geometry using AI vision-in-the-loop workflows.
